notes.title: Progress Update 3 + 4X fest event!
notes.notes:
Hello Lords & Ladies, it's time for another progress update regarding Before Arthur! However before we delve into it, I would like to start by thanking Steam for including us in the upcoming 4X fest running Aug 11th - 18th, and while we don't yet have a live demo, we hope to get a slight boost in visibility during the event.

Speaking of a demo, I've been hard at work inching towards that next milestone and hope to have an early demo available in the next 3 - 4 months. Before then, I also plan on launching a private pre-test so anyone interested in that leave a comment below and I'll respond with some details.

Now without further ado the update...



Throne Room Advisor

So, managing an entire kingdom is hard, but you don't have to do it alone! We added a personal advisor to your throne room who will give you guidance and general information on your subjects and rule. Through him you can also change things such as tax rates, vassal assignments and diplomacy (just to name a few).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/e85eddff3a9fe7c94facee3c2af28d2a55e0c975.png"]

Personalized Laws and Punishments

One of the newest features is the ability to set your own laws and punishments for your kingdom. The laws of the realm are broken down into two main categories. "High Crime", covering things such as murder & treason, and "Low Crime" such as theft, or disturbing the peace. Every kingdom in the game will be able to set different methods of determining guilt along with different methods of punishment.

Setting punishments too severe can lower crime at the expense of loyalty and gaining some tyrannical traits. On the flip side, setting punishments too softly may make you loved, but at the expense of rampant crime and banditry. As a ruler you will have to decide how you wish to be seen by the people while also balancing these two realities.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/355201f0558e9898ef64331b3b32af1717f4f588.gif"]



You will also have a number of "Methods of Proof" at your disposal each favored by different classes of your people, while also keeping with the strange ideas of "justice" of the times. 

Perhaps a trail by fire is the best way to determine a man's guilt? After all, your clergy seem to love it! Or, perhaps a good old fashioned trail by combat favored by the nobility. Each method also has a baseline of giving a fair verdict, with the better methods locked behind your tech tree. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/a1f03ac1706439107f65583d41b38f7f0ce25918.gif"]



Level Up's

The player (and NPC's) now gain experiance by their deeds and actions and can level up during the game. This means being able to assign skill points and improving your skills.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/df6046f35b4c090b95c0acaa4f15f97fa63730fb.gif"]



Camping

Sometimes you may find yourself far from your court or comfy bed and need to sleep. Or, perhaps you have marched your army all day and they need rest... Well now you can camp at your current location and rest. Besides sleep, camping will also allow you to cook and craft food items, hunt / forage, or set up defensive works to protect your forces. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/ff57e708e8ae28ab4cf3562615b17f790af1135d.png"]

Assigning Peasants To Buildings

We needed a way for production buildings to gather kingdom resources, so I decided to go with a (Kin) / family system. The number of families, or kin, will be tied into the overall population of each settlement, however the size of each family unit will grow (or shrink) throughout the game.

Also, assigning one kin group to a production building that has a size of three will produce less then a kin group that has a size of eight. The game will automatically assign the largest kin group available so you won't need to micro manage this too much... (unless you want to). 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/40aea2be9c1c73cb41b57ada051246ea61b5119e.gif"]



Plagues & Plotting

Let's face it, the dark ages had lot's of sickness and poor health conditions. So to that end I have added the chance of both the player and NPC's succumbing to illness. Sometimes this illness will be caused by an assassin and poison, well other times it could be from eating bad food or not taking proper care of yourself. The chance of dying from illness is decreased by your strength rating, hiring good healers, having the right traits, or crafting the right medicine.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/5ca94dc02679bb54d6b01a14601762a0b56b33f2.gif"]



Farming / Crop Planting

Lastly, I'm currently working on a way for the player to plant and grow crops both in your settlements or personal farms. Each plot will have a fertility rating that will decrease over time unless you fallow the fields and let them rest for a year. Some crop types will do better depending on weather, seasons and terrain types, and each farm will have a number of events that can either help or hinder growth. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/a51df406fdbdb1e2f049f71bccf955b7718a623e.gif"]



Other Stuff Added

Improved / polished UI (on going)

Implemented a message system & quest log

Marriage & courting lords and ladies (more on this next time!)

Added a way for the player to leave an army at their current location.

Added a caravan trade system and traveling merchants

Started adding quests



That about wrapes this up for now, but if you haven't already please consider wishlisting / following the game as we have lots of features and improvements to add and refine.

notes.title: Progress Update #2: Wolves, Feasts & Permadeath
notes.notes:
Hello lords and ladies! It's time for another update on the state of development...

 First, animals have started to appear in England! Wolves now wander the wilderness and are always looking for an easy meal... aka YOU! But they’re just the beginning—bears, deer, and wild boars lurk in the shadows, while farm animals (cattle, sheep, etc.) await domestication. Hunt / raise them for furs, hides, and savory meat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/0ce96b40556d18b16e84ccf71eb3d9ee57f20a00.gif

Master the culinary arts!
Combine ingredients to craft dishes like hearty stews (meat + veggies = survival gourmet). With many more recipes simmering in the cauldron for you to discover… 

Your throne room awaits!
Hold court to hear petitions from your vassals and subjects - With 60+ quests and court drama's already woven into this system. Rule wisely… or otherwise. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/4bbfac18bf39af481c3ab77cfa4ff85596fd5f21.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/0573223a811066e669d0c6c9e5b23dd4046f7cde.gif

Our main dialog UI has undergone a rework since the last one was looking a little... sad. I hope this one looks sharper,  while also displaying useful info about the person you're speaking to, including: 

 Their gold
 Renown
 Religion
 Traits and stats

(Keep in mind most of the icons are placeholders for now). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/138898cbf7d739143154c50d241f3467b2ee9e29.png

40+ technologies to dominate the land!
We have added over 40 new technologies that can be researched by both the player and the AI factions. Every tech unlocking a new building, ability, bonus or all of the above. The tech tree UI (show below) also hides techs unless you currently know the prerequisite(s).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/28a980762b83e1610e343b021475e3c1053532cd.png

Feast or scheme? Why not both?
The new feasting mechanic allows players to host great gatherings at their manor. Hold lavish banquets to reward loyalty… or discreetly poison your rivals. (We won’t judge.) Each feast is rated by the amount of food / drink and their variety, with truly epic gatherings gaining you both renown and relationship boasts.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/06c7b11e3b251ce0517a86a4e68a975ed89d74d6.gif

The stakes have never been higher...
Perma death seems like a good place to end this update, and it is just one more of the many features we have added / worked on or polished recently. Now the health bar actually means something and once depleted you die! If you have an heir, great! You can keep managing your realm as your offspring, but without an heir your game is over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/83d06ede2e7b388e383f8b0e9f9a96257c41b5f2.gif

Other stuff we've added...

 Reading books to increase stats
 Eating food to increase health & remove hunger
 Writing personalized poems / letters to send to NPC's
 Weapon animation and hit speeds are dependent on weapon weight and skill
 Building of walls and fort defenses
 Blood splatter and hit animations (recently added, not shown in gifs)

The adventure’s just beginning!
There is still a lot I want to add, polish and integrate, so please consider wishlisting and following the development! As always feel free to leave any comments / suggestions below and I'll be happy to consider them.

notes.title: Steam Progress Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello lords and ladies! We have now had our steam page live for two months (time flys) :) so I thought it would be a good time to update everyone on the current state of development. As some of you may have noticed we have been updating the steam page with our development to showcase new gifs and images and this will continue.  

But let's dive into the major improvements, features and developments thus far...

Battle System

The first major feature added since we launched our steam page has been the added ability to fight large scale battles. The player can now raise armies either by talking to their advisor or by using an army UI interface. The player will be able to lead their army personally, or appoint one of their lords to do it for them. They can have the army follow the player, or leave the army resting at camp if the player wishes to explore on their own.

If you meet a hostile army in the open world while leading your own army, a battle will trigger within the same world position the two armies met. Meaning each battleground will be different depending on that world position. 

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/af08274de0529cda3e4da5e1d8b8297c4c30372e.gif

As you can imagine, changing battlefields will mean different tactics for you and your opponent. Is there a bridge nearby that could be used for defense? Perhaps the enemy is strong in bowmen, but luckily there is a forest nearby that can negate some of those arrows!

During the course of the battle you will be able to form different battlegroups and issue orders to those groups in real time (forward, back, charge, flank, etc). They will also be able to have these groups form different formations to counter the enemy, as some formations will have an advantage when fighting others. 

As you can see from the Work in Progress (WIP) image above we still need to polish this a bit and change the distance of weapons so that a hit looks more like an actual hit. ;)

Road Building & Improved UI

The second thing we added since the page launch was the ability for the player to build roads throughout their kingdom, while also making some improvements to the overall building construction UI. 

The road system will eventually be tied into the AI pathfinding mechanics and will improve movement speeds while traveling. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/d87486dcf66ec3f51833b5a5caa80e40c717be5f.gif

We also plan on adding a bridge building mechanic to allow the player and NPC's to cross major rivers and we hope to have this done soon. Also speaking of building things, we have added a bunch of new buildings you will be able to construct with many more on the way.  

New Shop and Furniture

We have just finished adding a new shop that will allow the player to purchase furniture for their manors and halls. Some items will grant bonuses when your subjects come to court, while other items will unlock new abilities and features. 

For example buying a better bed will allow you to sleep and improve your mood over sleeping on a hay floor. A larger dining table will allow you to invite more subjects and lords to your feasts, and a throne will allow you to hold court. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/894fdb6027c33143ad376b34607108b155e62b93.gif

Some items can be upgraded, while others can be replaced with better items from the shop as they become available. Your shop's items are also tied to your kingdom's current tech level, so shop item availability will change during the game.

Besides the shop, the player may find some truly legendary items while exploring the open world. 

Decorating Your Manor

What good is a shop if you have nowhere to put your new purchases? So, we have also added a new decoration mood to allow you a way of placing your new items, choosing their position, rotation and colour options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/47f2d4380258c6295f51b695be4ee6cb1fd3fc0e.gif 

Storing Items in Chests

Sometimes it will be prudent to store your most valuable items in your locked chest, after all thieves are everywhere, and maybe you don't want to risk losing that shiny crown if your monarch dies in battle.

To that end we have added the ability for the player to store items away for safekeeping. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410000/b511a334f519a521ea25b49375dc801536d88782.gif

What's Next?

So that is some of the major stuff I've worked on in the last few months, but what's next? Well here is a short list of just some of the things you can expect to see in future updates...


 Farm animals
 Farming and growing crops
 Horses and Horseback riding
 Fishing & Hunting
 AI Pathfinding and better subject spawning
 Kingdom research and tech
 Cooking & eating
 Building of forts and castles
 Mini games
 Quests
 Holding court and answering subjects
 Sending and receiving personal messages
 Marriage and children
 Random, legendary and historical events
 Polish, polish and more polish
 And more...
